newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates drop on excess liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates drop on excess liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates dropped on Friday amid excess liquidity in the system and dealers said rates would remain low on Saturday.
"With yesterday's liquid close, trading started on a low note," a dealer at KASB & Co said.
He said initial bids were at 5.0 percent and offers at 10. But the gap narrowed and some deals were struck at 4.0 percent. "Towards the close rates plunged to 3.0 and 2.0 percent."
The market closed with surplus funds and dealers said on Saturday the rates would stay low. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
